description:
It was discovered that libvirt had an integer overflow vulnerability in
the NodeGetFreePages RPC handler. A local attacker could possibly use
this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2026-18917)

It was discovered that libvirt did not correctly handle symbolic links
when changing ownership of the TPM emulator log file. A local attacker
with access to the swtpm account could possibly use this issue to cause libvirt
to change the ownership of an arbitrary file. (CVE-2026-77159)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in libvirt.
title: libvirt vulnerabilities
